profile.headline: Lead, Software Engineer
profile.summary: Senior Software Engineer with 17+ years of experience in delivering scalable, high-performance systems across industries like Capital Markets, Investment Banking, and Insurance. Expertise in full-stack development, cloud-native solutions, and system modernization using Java, Python, Scala, AWS, Spring, and microservices. Proven leader in driving digital transformation, optimizing workflows, and delivering innovative solutions with cross-functional teams to meet business objectives and enhance user experiences.

positions.title: Lead Software Engineer
positions.locationName: Newark, New Jersey, United States · Hybrid
positions.description:
•	Led the modernization of a legacy Customer Data Platform to a cloud-native architecture, reducing system complexity and enabling a 30% reduction in operational costs .

•	Architected and developed microservices and APIs using Java, Spring Boot, and AWS, driving automation that contributed to $10M+ in annual savings, utilizing experience with distributed systems to optimize scalability and performance.

•	Led the migration of 50M+ customer records from legacy systems to a unified cloud platform, improving data consistency and eliminating production issues through cross-team collaboration with Master Data Management.
positions.insights: Skills: Java · Core Java · Spring Boot · Spring Batch · Python (Programming Language) · Amazon Web Services (AWS) · AWS Lambda · AWS CloudFormation · AWS Step Functions · Document DB · Amazon SQS · Amazon Simple Notification Service (SNS) · AWS Event bridge · AWS Glue · Amazon CloudWatch · SQL · PL/SQL · Oracle · NoSQL · DB2 · Docker · Git · JIRA · Apigee API Management · Postman API · ActiveMQ · Angular · React.js · Continuous Integration and Continuous Delivery (CI/CD) · Jenkins · Sonarqube · Checkmarks · Studio 3T · Splunk · Dynatrace · Leading Development Teams

positions.title: Application Developer
positions.description:
•	Led the design and implementation of a global markets client onboarding system, streamlining workflows and reducing client onboarding time by 40%. The system, built on the JOLT enterprise workflow management platform, automates and organizes business processes into a sequence of tasks, ensuring they are delivered to the right teams or systems at the optimal time and in the correct order.
•	Enhanced rule engines and UI components to drive end-to-end automation, improving system efficiency and user experience.
positions.insights: Skills: Java · Scala · Spring · JOLT · Java Script · jQuery · Ext JS · Maven

positions.title: Technology Analyst
positions.description:
Worked for Clarient Global LLC Joint venture between DTCC and 5 Global banks. 
•	Designed and implemented RESTful microservices to streamline client onboarding and integrate systems across enterprise environments.
•	Improved system availability and transaction processing using Spring and Hibernate, reducing downtime and increasing transaction throughput.
positions.insights: Skills: Java · JAX-RS · Spring · Hibernate · Oracle · Maven · Git

positions.title: Technology Analyst
positions.description: MiddleTier (Giant) is the UBS Investment Bank service which connects to different trade processing unit and depending on the criteria it process the data to downstream systems. Involved in develop a new service/application which is the part of Giant architecture. It fetched the data from GMI (Global Markets and Investment Banking) and transforms the data as per Futures industry standard (FIA) and send the transformed data file to FIA. Then Enhanced the application to support the Rate’s Hub activities. Rates Hub send the message to the system and system responded according by fetching data (rates) from GMI and send it to the desired downstream locations.

positions.title: Software Developer
positions.description: Enhancement and Application Support of Advent Geneva. Geneva is a part of Global Prime Brokerage architecture. Involved in Customizations of Reports and Adapter changes for various requests, which are build on Java.

educations.schoolName: Biju Patnaik University of Technology, Odisha
